rules: When the understanding files, style notes and visual plan (if any), and outline are written and the writer's own gates passed, and the package is ready for the pre-draft review.
When the full draft package is written and ready for draft review, or revised after a review.
When review-report.md decides Pass: the writer delivers the final package to the user.
When review-report.md names a gap or revision (any decision other than Pass) and lists the required revisions.
